claims.verbatim:
The steamship China at Halifax reports had fine weather.
On April 30, lat 51, lon 13[?], passed the Hecla, bound west;
May 2, lat 48 35, lon 33 55[?], saw (supposed) steamer Atlanta,
bound west; 3d, lat 46 23, lon 40 51, spoke bark Gibraltar (Br);
lat 45 57, lon 41 47, spoke City of London (not the steamer),
bound east; 5th, lat 43 20, lon 54 35, spoke ship Maroborough,
bound west.

claims.verbatim:
The European files of the China reached this city
from Boston at an early hour yesterday morning, bring-
ing our papers and special correspondence dated to 28th
of April. From both sources we have very interesting
details of the telegraphic summary of the news from Hal-
ifax which was published in the HERALD on Tuesday.
